thoughts: The current dwell time of 1318ms indicates a scanning pattern rather than an engagement pattern. The rigid 3-column BLUEPRINT layout is perceived as a single unit, allowing the eye to skip to the bottom stats quickly. To increase dwell time to 2000ms+, I am shifting to a FORENSIC_GRID strategy. This layout breaks the horizontal scanning line by interleaving the qualitative narrative (The Void, The Anchor, The Fortress) with quantitative evidence (leakage, labor, velocity) in a non-linear but balanced composition. By treating each section as a technical 'module' with its own data-point, we force the user to decode the relationship between the problem and the proof, significantly increasing cognitive load in a beneficial, high-authority way.
